objective: Audit the pinned StarEmbed ZTF_40k source splits and test whether the frozen v0.2.0 42-feature input path can process a deterministic clean subset without training or predicting.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #210 and PR #211 recorded one duplicate SourceID within the StarEmbed train split and one train/test SourceID overlap; source lineage and split-generation semantics remain unresolved.
StarEmbed has a seven-class taxonomy and is not mapped to the frozen 15-class v0.2.0 production taxonomy.
The experiment is input compatibility only. It must not report model accuracy or alter the v0.2.0 model, features, class order, benchmark, or acceptance criteria.
The initial PR #290 CI run 43684816288 failed Ruff because star_embed_input.py had a missing comma and skipped downstream stages.
The dedicated source workflow later acquired all five Parquet files and reproduced the duplicate/overlap findings. Its shell exited at the audit failure before it ran the feature-input probe.

baseline.model: Frozen v0.2.0 feature extractor only; no model inference

sample.policy: exclude duplicated test IDs and IDs overlapping any other split

change.proposed: Capture the source-audit exit code without aborting the shell, run the independent clean-test feature probe, upload both reports, and enforce the original fail-closed gate after evidence upload.
change.scope: Research branch only: dedicated workflow and this lifecycle record. No production or frozen baseline changes.
change.rationale: The first source-backed run correctly detected dataset leakage but did not run the clean-test input probe because GitHub Actions bash starts with errexit enabled. The corrected workflow must preserve both the leakage blocker and diagnostic feature evidence.

expected_improvement: Retain exact hashes and row counts for all five pinned Parquet artifacts.
Report duplicate IDs and cross-split overlaps without weakening fail-closed behavior.
Run the deterministic 50-object feature-input probe on unique test IDs that do not overlap any other split.
Upload source audit and feature probe outputs even when the global source-integrity gate fails.
Keep all StarEmbed classifier-performance claims out of scope.

correctness.before: The source audit returned exit code 2 and the shell stopped before the feature-input probe. The final gate then received empty output values.
correctness.after: The workflow now disables errexit only while capturing both diagnostic return codes. It restores errexit before writing the step outputs. The final gate still fails if either diagnostic returns non-zero.

reproducibility.before: The source acquisition and identity audit completed, but the 50-object feature probe did not run.
reproducibility.after: The acquisition manifest records all five file hashes. The identity audit used seed 20261115 and selected 50 test IDs. A new run is required to produce and inspect feature-probe evidence.

measurement.trade_off: The workflow will run a diagnostic feature probe on a clean test subset even when the overall source split is blocked. It will still fail the final gate while any global duplicate or cross-split overlap remains.

validation.blocker: The duplicate train SourceID and train/test overlap remain unexplained. The clean-test feature probe must be rerun and inspected. Benchmark acceptance remains blocked.

root_causes: The source dataset contains one duplicate SourceID within train: CSS_J164349.2+401208.
The source dataset contains one SourceID shared by train and test: CSS_J051729.2+083846.

The workflow's source-audit step used set -uo pipefail but inherited GitHub Actions bash errexit. The audit command returned 2, so the shell exited before capturing its return code or running the feature probe. The final gate received empty output values.
unresolved: The source-generation reason for the duplicate train SourceID is unknown.
The source-generation reason for the train/test overlap is unknown.
The clean 50-object feature-input probe has not yet been executed on the acquired source snapshot.
limitations: A successful feature-input probe does not establish classifier accuracy, taxonomy compatibility or independent scientific validation.
The 50-object sample is diagnostic and cannot establish population-level performance.
No production model inference or training is in scope.

findings: The pinned source package is downloadable and its five Parquet file hashes are recorded.
The source audit found one duplicate train SourceID and one train/test SourceID overlap.
The 50-object deterministic test sample is selected after stable SourceID sorting with seed 20261115.
The input adapter excludes duplicated test IDs and IDs that overlap any other split before selecting the feature probe sample.
The feature probe reports global split leakage and remains blocked while any duplicate or overlap exists.

open_blockers: Run the corrected StarEmbed workflow and confirm both audit and input-probe reports are uploaded.
Inspect the number of feature vectors generated, feature width/order hash, per-object failures and sample exclusions.
Confirm the final workflow gate fails while duplicate or cross-split overlap remains.
Trace the duplicate and overlap SourceIDs to the source dataset's split-generation provenance.
Do not claim benchmark acceptance while any source split duplicate or cross-split overlap remains unexplained.
Do not map StarEmbed's seven classes to the frozen v0.2.0 15-class taxonomy.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not train or run predictions on StarEmbed as if its seven classes map to the frozen 15-class production taxonomy.
Do not weaken duplicate or cross-split leakage checks.
Do not change the v0.2.0 feature definitions, model artifact, class order or benchmark.
Run the clean 50-object feature-input diagnostic even when global leakage blocks benchmark acceptance, then retain both results.
Keep PR #290 Draft until the source identity findings and feature-input evidence are reviewed.
